meta.title: Add BUN_OPTIONS env var
meta.body_summary: Add BUN_OPTIONS environment variable to pass additional CLI options to bun, including a parser for quoted arguments and integration into initArgv.

perf_labels.notes: Codex PR added BUN_OPTIONS; reviewed for correctness, fixed compile error and quote handling via claude-bot commits; merged after nektro approval with tests.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 12931 changed lines, this is a large change by absolute volume, but most changes are from merges from main rather than the feature itself. The core feature change (~356 lines in bun.zig and test file) is small. As a feature addition PR with small effective scope, it merged after review cycle.

review_details.concern_detail: Initial code had variable shadowing causing compile error; parsing didn't handle quoted arguments correctly, causing test failures.
review_details.performance_claim: Copy argv slices with @memcpy and avoid unnecessary allocations for efficiency.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent-generated code required human intervention to fix compile error, add tests, and correct quoted argument parsing. Process boundary: agent needed explicit instructions and review to reach mergeable state.

detection_detail.code_reading: nektro reviewed escape handling and memory cleanup, graphite-app bot flagged escape edge case.
detection_detail.ci_auto: robobun reported CI failures on spawn test, not directly related to BUN_OPTIONS but triggered investigation.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance evidence; feature correctness verified via tests.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Compile error, quoting bugs, and test failures fixed by claude-bot commits within the PR.

core_change_summary.description: Added parseOptionsEnv to src/bun.zig to split BUN_OPTIONS environment variable into arguments, handling quoted strings and escapes. Integrated into initArgv to prepend these options before user-provided arguments. Added test file test/cli/env/bun-options.test.ts covering basic, multiple, quoted options, priority, and empty variable cases.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Merge commits brought in unrelated changes from main (node-fallbacks, lockfiles, etc.).
change_trajectory: Initial refine of BUN_OPTIONS handling in src/bun.zig (commit 04f36ebc).
Claude-bot added test file test/cli/env/bun-options.test.ts with five test cases (commit 23433d1d).
First attempt to fix quoted arguments for --print only (commit cb2ea68).
Generalized quote handling for all options (commit 6ea371400).
Two merge commits from main (commits c4e38a2a, 9673dc14) brought unrelated changes.

review_signals.summary: Escape sequence handling doesn't account for a trailing backslash at the end of the string.
review_signals.action_taken: nektro replied that the while loop handles OOB and losing a backslash is acceptable.

review_signals.summary: Recommend adding defer buf.deinit() to prevent memory leaks in error scenarios.
review_signals.action_taken: nektro replied that buf.toOwnedSlice handles cleanup.

review_signals.summary: Accepted trailing backslash edge case as low risk.
Approved with comment 'more varied tests would be preferable but lgtm'.
Reported 1 failure in spawn.test.ts on Windows x64, not directly related to BUN_OPTIONS.
Requested claude-bot to fix compile error, add tests, and fix quoting bugs.
review_signals.action_taken: Claude-bot pushed fixes in multiple commits.
